title: Private Tour Lunenburg UNESCO Heritage and Mahone Bay Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the breathtaking beauty of Nova Scotia on a private journey to the world-famous Peggy's Cove. Travel along the scenic Lighthouse Route, visit the iconic lighthouse, explore the charming fishing village, and enjoy spectacular Atlantic Ocean views. With comfortable transportation, flexible stops, and personalized service, this tour offers the perfect blend of history, nature, and local culture. Ideal for couples, families, cruise passengers, and small groups looking for an authentic Nova Scotia experience.
